title: Stock transfer
sub: Shop floor and warehouse — in transit, partial receipt and rejection at the destination
stock.sub: Server stock at each place — view only; “Total” is all of these places.
stock.empty: No products in server stock yet.
stock.stale: May not be current: a device has not sent everything yet.
readonly: View only — sending and receiving need the “move stock” permission.
draft.title: New transfer
draft.saved: The draft stays in this browser until you send it.
draft.same: Source and destination are the same.
draft.badQty: Quantity on row {n} is not valid (positive number, up to three decimals).
draft.sent: Transfer sent — the goods are in transit.
detail.title: Transfer
recv.title: Receive at {to}
recv.final: Close the transfer (anything not received is short)
recv.over: Received quantity on row {n} is more than what is in transit.
recv.badQty: Received quantity on row {n} is not valid.
recv.nothing: Nothing received in this step — enter a quantity or tick “Close the transfer”.
recv.needReason: Write a reason for the shortage.
rej.title: Reject transfer
rej.hint: What is still in transit goes back to the source; what arrived stays.
err.network: Connection lost. Try again — no step is recorded twice.
err.insufficient_stock: Not enough stock at the source.
err.product_not_found: A product is not in the server catalog.
err.over_received: Received is more than what is in transit.
err.product_not_in_transfer: This product is not in the transfer.
err.location_out_of_scope: This stock location is outside your access.
err.idempotency_key_reused: This form's earlier attempt was already recorded (its reply was lost) — nothing was recorded twice. The list is refreshed; press again only if you want another one.
err.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
